CONTEXT: Last failing check was packages/gateway typecheck, but also CI failed on packages/runtime. Two recent commits by different authors. Irreversible force-push is not allowed without confirmation.
state.policy: Decide-1 coarse only — no tool names. If user_must_clarify is high → ask_human. If multi_deliverable is high → prefer spawn_subtasks over tool_call. If reads_before_gen is high → prefer spawn_subtasks (read children then gen child), not bare escalate_gen. escalate_gen only when no prior tool reads are required. tool_call only for a single deterministic tool with clear args.

criteria.tool_call: Exactly one deterministic tool; args present; not multi-deliverable
criteria.escalate_gen: Pure generation; no required prior tool reads
criteria.ask_human: Vague, identity-ambiguous, or irreversible+low-conf — ask first

veto_tool_call.instructions: Should tool_call be vetoed because the request is multi-part or needs prior reads?

veto_bare_gen.instructions: Should bare escalate_gen be vetoed because reads must happen first?
